@truongdq01/tokens.purpose: Design tokens: primitive, semantic, component, brand, and motion values
useWhen: Defining or extending the design system token pipeline
Referencing token types in headless or theme code
Low-level design math without React components
doNotUseFor: Direct imports in app screens for one-off styling (prefer useTheme/useTokens via headless)

@truongdq01/headless.purpose: ThemeProvider, theme hooks, behavior hooks, accessibility helpers, and motion primitives
useWhen: Reading theme/tokens with useTheme, useTokens, useIsDark
Shared interaction logic (usePressable, useModal, useToast, useSelect, etc.)
Building custom components that need RNUI behavior without styled opinions
doNotUseFor: Styled UI in app screens when @truongdq01/ui already exports a component
Duplicating component visuals that exist in @truongdq01/ui

@truongdq01/ui.purpose: Styled React Native UI components — primary import for app screens
useWhen: Any standard UI: buttons, inputs, cards, lists, modals, feedback
Re-exported ThemeProvider and theme hooks for convenience
doNotUseFor: Defining new design tokens (use tokens package)
Heavy business logic (keep in app hooks/services)
Bundling or re-wrapping native modules inside the library

@truongdq01/themes.purpose: Pre-built brand theme presets (default, ocean, forest, etc.)
useWhen: Applying a packaged brand to ThemeProvider
doNotUseFor: One-off app colors (use ThemeProvider overrides instead)
Replacing semantic tokens in the tokens package

apps/example.purpose: Expo example app with per-component showcase screens
doNotUseFor: Importing example code into published packages
Treating showcase screens as type-safe canonical API reference (some drift exists)
